content: To further evaluate if a variation of the parameters INLINEFORM0 (the number of discriminator iterations per generator iteration), INLINEFORM1 (the number of units in hidden layer) and the structure of generator INLINEFORM2 will impact the extraction performance, additional experiments have been conducted on the Google dataset, with INLINEFORM3 set to 5, 7 and 10, INLINEFORM4 set to 100, 150 and 200, and three INLINEFORM5 structures (3, 4 and 5 layers). The comparison results on precision, recall and F-measure are shown in Figure FIGREF20 . From the results, it could be observed that AEM with the 5-layer generator performs the best and achieves 96.7% in F-measure, and the worst F-measure obtained by AEM is 85.7%. Overall, the AEM outperforms all compared approaches acorss various parameter settings, showing relatively stable performance.
